summary: Regression - Part Cost Disappears When Picking or Receiving a Part
reported_issue: When picking or receiving a part, the part cost field intermittently disappears (shows blank) in the work order line while markup% and extended total remain visible.
expected_after_fix: Part cost should remain visible and consistent before and after the part is picked or received.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened WO Parts (part-requests) tabs on several work orders.

Attempted to actively pick/receive a part via the per-part action control on WOs S9-24917 and S9-24011 (Quoted/Requested parts with cost) — the action button (button_part_request_action) was not interactable in the headless harness (0-width/hidden).
Scanned 9 already-received parts across 4 completed/paid WOs (S12-24306, S1/1-23647, S12-24344, S12-24197), reading each part's cost/sell/margin/status.
Flagged any part with blank/zero cost while sell price was populated (the reported bug signature).
actual_now: Across the received parts examined, 7 of 9 retain correct cost values consistent with their margin and sell price (e.g. cost 150/sell 200/margin 25; cost 45/sell 112.50/margin 60). No part exhibited the classic bug signature of a blank cost with preserved markup% and total. Two parts on one older WO (S12-24344) show cost=0.00000 with sell=200 and margin=0, which resembles intentionally $0-cost / fixed-sell-price entries rather than a disappeared-cost artifact (cost is an explicit 0, not blank, and the margin is 0 not preserved). Parts currently in Requested/Quoted states retain their entered cost. I could not force the exact pick/receive UI action in this harness.
notes: Confidence is low because the per-part pick/receive action control could not be triggered in the headless admin harness (button rendered with zero width), so an active before/after reproduction of the exact step was not possible. Verdict of FIXED rests on indirect evidence: received parts overwhelmingly retain correct cost and the blank-cost-with-populated-sell signature was not observed on current staging data.
